instruction.text: Select all the plants in the picture.
instruction.sound: We are in Molly’s room. Look closely. Can you find all the plants here? Select all the plants in the picture.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>dry-leaves-rustle</voice> <break time='500ms'/>You’ve found all the plants. Awesome!

instruction.text: Select all the ducks in the bathroom.
instruction.sound: And can you find all the rubber ducks? Select all the ducks in the bathroom.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>duck</voice> <break time='500ms'/> Well spotted!

instruction.text: Select all the cats in the kitchen.
instruction.sound: So many cats! Can you find them all? Select all the cats in the kitchen.

trainers.finishSound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>cat-cartoon</voice> <break time='500ms'/> You’ve found all the cats. Well done!
